title: 223. Path With Minimum Effort

examples.explanation: The route of [1,3,5,3,5] has a maximum absolute difference of 2 in consecutive cells. This is better than the route of [1,2,2,2,5], where the maximum absolute difference is 3.
The route of [1,2,3,4,5] has a maximum absolute difference of 1 in consecutive cells, which is better than route [1,3,5,3,5].
This route does not require any effort.

hints: Consider the grid as a graph, where adjacent cells have an edge with cost of the difference between the cells.
If you are given threshold k, check if it is possible to go from (0, 0) to (n-1, m-1) using only edges of cost at most k.
